scope: Mac simulator architecture; no robot connection or motion

new_architecture.observations: rendered RGB-D, calibrated camera and robot FK, odometry and lidar
new_architecture.learning: separate experimental one-step residual regressors; preserved phase-labelled demonstrations; not automatically executed

observed_execution_diagnostic.reason: Camera has not localized a container; no transport attempted

validation.browser: New panel loaded without console errors; its button launched one finite physics diagnostic. Holding confirmed; delivery correctly not accepted.
validation.stop_regression: STOP cancels active skill trial; focus loss does not. Reset, pause and recording are blocked during the trial. Cancellation persists a paused report.
validation.goal_resume: Multi-task workshop identifiers persist before preparation. Resume reuses them and archived ACT state cannot override the new result.

remaining: Select a reachable observation stance for the 30 cm basket using observed rim geometry, collision checks and fresh depth; no assumed cavity.
Qualify temporal placement evidence with actual release renders; full task execution is still not accepted.
Preserve the verified grip during the free-pitch transport-posture change after the destination survey; the paired current diagnostic now isolates actual material loss at this later motion.
Generalize the perception and grasp primitives across the unchanged scene distribution.
Validate two independent ten-scene groups and qualify exact software/artifact checksums before transfer.
Commission real semantic recognition, hand-eye calibration and dynamics separately on hardware.

destination_survey.implemented: Bounded pregrasp and post-approach RGBD camera survey; gripper state preserved; cached geometry used only for aiming.
destination_survey.observed_12cm_basket: Two distinct complete views agreed within approximately 1 mm; uncertainty includes an explicit estimated 12 mm simulation floor.
destination_survey.observed_30cm_basket: Six bounded views plus three diagnostic elevated views: rim visible, central cavity occluded. Result unknown before pickup.

placement_verification.source: One pre-release image of held material and release area, plus two post-release RGBD images.

camera_feasibility_fix.problem: The previous camera optimiser checked only lateral aim error; requested height and range could be missed while the motion was accepted.
camera_feasibility_fix.change: Robot-only multistart IK recomputes pose constraints from FK; rejects missing height or range before motion, then checks physically reached height.
camera_feasibility_fix.low_basket_result: Two complete views, baseline 6.8 cm, bound disagreement 1.15 mm, visible opening 4469 pixels. Diagnostic only.
camera_feasibility_fix.high_basket_result: No complete opening in the bounded survey. Result unknown; no pickup or release.
camera_feasibility_fix.inspection_stance_probes: A measured-rim approach to 34 cm standoff did not obtain a feasible complete view; all raw observations and commands retained in diagnostics/inspection-stance-*.
camera_feasibility_fix.scope: This fixes pose acceptance, not complete high-basket inspection or delivery.

distinct_survey_budget_fix.problem: Repeated camera hints consumed the view budget, skipping remaining unique directions.
distinct_survey_budget_fix.change: Only distinct attempted viewpoints count towards max_views. The existing pose, opening, uncertainty and physics gates are unchanged.
distinct_survey_budget_fix.low_basket_result: Success from two complete registered views.
distinct_survey_budget_fix.high_basket_result: Seven distinct views attempted within a budget of eight. Opening remains unconfirmed; no pickup.

high_basket_stance_diagnosis.result: No complete rim plus central-floor view found among examined pose/stance combinations. This bounded search is not proof of physical impossibility.
high_basket_stance_diagnosis.next: Investigate active observations and clearance for alternative viewpoints; do not relax observation requirements or infer an unseen cavity.

hold_probe_orientation_fix.problem: A nominal 2 cm vertical hold probe used unconstrained wrist pitch. A previous failed run commanded a pitch change of approximately 4.25 degrees during verification.
hold_probe_orientation_fix.change: Prefer a small pose-constrained translation; if upward translation is infeasible, plan a 2 cm bodyward probe while retaining the measured hand orientation and closed gripper.
hold_probe_orientation_fix.baseline_result: Hold confirmed, both pads in contact, camera rotated 4.382 degrees. This run did not reproduce the older loss of grip.
hold_probe_orientation_fix.proposed_result: Hold confirmed from two frames; both pads in contact; hold duration 3.85 s; camera rotated 1.657 degrees; hand rotated 1.654 degrees; bodyward displacement 2.479 cm.

high_basket_active_view_diagnosis.scope: Robot-only pose feasibility from a preserved measured rim; static sensor fixtures are not executed paths or task trials.
high_basket_active_view_diagnosis.result: A floor-only idealized ray fit appeared feasible, but the actual rendered static viewpoint yielded only three central below-rim depth pixels and no complete container. The separate post-observation evaluator found 6.26 mm overlap between the gripper linkage and the basket. This candidate is rejected.
high_basket_active_view_diagnosis.pose_optimizer_limits: Thirty-two starts with corrected own gripper mimic FK did not find a pose satisfying the added central-jaw constraint. This is not a proof of impossibility.
high_basket_active_view_diagnosis.model_limitation: An outer bounding ellipse alone does not establish a clear sightline through a finite-thickness rim or free space for the fingers.
high_basket_active_view_diagnosis.next: Use actual observed rim/inner-wall geometry and swept robot CAD clearance before any closer inspection motion. Partial views remain nonactionable. Continue testing lower-basket delivery independently.

hand_frame_tracking_fix.problem: Tracking compared center-minus-jaw offsets in world axes after the hand rotated. A held patch could be refused despite unchanged position in the hand frame.
hand_frame_tracking_fix.change: Store the measured arm5 orientation with the verified hold. Compare each offset in its own hand frame; retain the 25 mm displacement limit and all existing appearance, visibility, lift and probe gates. Missing orientation or nonfinite displacement is unknown.
hand_frame_tracking_fix.baseline_result: Stopped immediately after the destination survey on world-relative offset mismatch; independent physics still confirmed both pads in contact.
hand_frame_tracking_fix.candidate_result: Passed the post-survey tracking check and reached the transport-posture motion. That later motion lost the material; visual tracking correctly refused further transport and independent physics confirmed both contacts lost.
hand_frame_tracking_fix.tests: 115 passed and 3 subtests across executor, adapter, workshop/API, perception, planning and placement. Added rotating-hand rigid-offset, real 30 mm slip and missing-orientation cases.
hand_frame_tracking_fix.next: Avoid the unnecessary free-pitch transport-posture change or plan it with measured hold orientation and clearance; do not relax hold evidence.
